docs.title: Auditable agentic reinforcement learning
docs.text:
HarborRL connects verifiable Harbor tasks, a tool-using agent harness, model serving, trajectory evidence, and GRPO updates in one reproducible pipeline. Start on a CPU, then carry the same contracts into a native GPU deployment.

Run the CPU walkthrough Understand the architecture

docs.title: What is implemented today
docs.text:
HarborRL validates combinations before launch. The current registry is intentionally small and explicit:

MATH dimension Registered implementation Contract Model Qwen (qwen) Qwen tool calls served by SGLang Algorithm GRPO (grpo) Slime v0.3.2 native hooks Tasks Native Harbor JSON and JSONL catalogs Content-digested, verifier-backed tasks Harness Claude Code (claude_code) Harbor 0.23.0, Anthropic Messages v1

The registry is the support boundary

Names mentioned by upstream task collections or roadmap material are not supported merely because they exist elsewhere. Use harborrl list ... or harborrl options ... to query the running installation.
